ValidationRule.description: Orders for 3rd party suppliers must be set to the type of "Invoicing" otherwise the customer won't get charged
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(Supplier__r.Name <> "First Mile Ltd", ISPICKVAL( Type__c , "Delivery"), NOT(CONTAINS(Product__r.Name , "Clearance")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Orders for 3rd party suppliers must be set to the type of "Invoicing" otherwise the customer won't get charged.
